n57a7e8ac98c.s: The Agriculture Orientation Index is published by:
n57a7e8ac98c.x: The Agriculture Orientation Index is published by FAO, not IFPRI.

nindian-economy-63-9.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: World Social Security Report – World Bank
nindian-economy-63-9.x: The Global Wage Report is the ILO's study of wage trends; the World Social Security Report (now the World Social Protection Report) is also an ILO report.

nb25018b75b4.s: How many indicators does the Global Hunger Index use?
nb25018b75b4.x: The GHI uses four indicators: undernourishment, child stunting, child wasting and child mortality.

n3f08ea3d363.s: How many input pillars does the Global Innovation Index have?
n3f08ea3d363.x: The GII has five input pillars and two output pillars.

nee8307ce2f6.s: Through its resource-supply function, the environment provides:
nee8307ce2f6.x: The resource-supply function means the environment provides both renewable and non-renewable resources.

nce023e3f5ab.s: The Expert Group on Green National Accounts, set up in 2011, was chaired by:
nce023e3f5ab.x: The Expert Group was chaired by Sir Partha Dasgupta; it was set up in 2011 and reported in 2013.

n30b621f6f6b.s: Which of the following pairs about India in the SDSN Sustainable Development Report 2026 is correctly matched?
o: Neighbour India ranked ahead of – Bhutan
n30b621f6f6b.x: India ranked 94th, behind Bhutan, Maldives, Nepal and Sri Lanka, lagged on 13 SDGs, and SDG 2 was its main concern.

new.s: The Global Hunger Index is published jointly by:
new.x: The GHI is published by Concern Worldwide (Ireland) and Welthungerhilfe (Germany).

new.s: The Environmental Performance Index is prepared by:
new.x: The EPI is prepared by Yale and Columbia Universities; Cornell and INSEAD partner WIPO on the Global Innovation Index.

new.s: The World Happiness Report is published by:
new.x: The World Happiness Report is published by the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN).

new.s: The International IP Index is published by the Global Innovation Policy Center of the:
new.x: The International IP Index comes from the Global Innovation Policy Center of the US Chamber of Commerce.

new.s: The Global Talent Competitiveness Index is published by:
new.x: The Global Talent Competitiveness Index is published by INSEAD.

new.s: The Corruption Perceptions Index is published by:
new.x: The Corruption Perceptions Index is brought out by Transparency International.

new.s: The Logistics Performance Index is published by the:
new.x: The Logistics Performance Index is a World Bank index; India ranked 38th in 2023.

new.s: The first Global Gender Gap Report was published in:
new.x: The WEF's Global Gender Gap Report was first published in 2006.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about WIPO:
1. It was established in 1967.
2. It is headquartered in Geneva.
3. It has 193 members.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: WIPO, a UN agency set up in 1967, is based in Geneva and has 193 members.

new.s: Which country topped the World Bank's Doing Business 2019 report?
new.x: New Zealand topped Doing Business 2019, in which India ranked 77th.

new.s: In the Global Hunger Index 2025, India was ranked:
new.x: India was 102nd of 123 in GHI 2025 with a score of 25.8 ('serious'); it was 105th in 2024 and 100th in 2017.

new.s: In the World Happiness Report 2026, India's rank was:
new.x: India rose to 116th in WHR 2026; it was 126th in 2023 and 2024, 136th in 2022 and 139th in 2021.

new.s: Which country topped the World Happiness Report 2026 for the ninth year running?
new.x: Finland was the happiest country for the ninth year running in WHR 2026.

new.s: In the Global Innovation Index 2025, India was ranked:
new.x: India was 38th of 139 in GII 2025; 42nd was its International IP Index 2024 rank and 54th its StartupBlink rank.

new.s: Which country topped the Global Innovation Index 2025 for the 15th straight year?
new.x: Switzerland topped the GII for the 15th straight year in 2025.

new.s: In the Global Gender Gap Index 2025, India was ranked:
new.x: India was 131st of 148 in 2025; it was 112th of 153 in 2020.

new.s: In the Environmental Performance Index 2026, India's rank in Air Quality was:
new.x: India was 175th in Air Quality, 176th of 177 overall and 130th in Climate Mitigation in EPI 2026.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT among India's objections to the Environmental Performance Index?
o: It uses absolute rather than per-capita emissions
Three of its four indicators cover only children
new.x: Indicators covering only children is India's objection to the Global Hunger Index, not to the EPI.

new.s: Which Ministry rejected the Environmental Performance Index in 2022?
o: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
new.x: The MoEFCC rejected the EPI in 2022, objecting to its use of absolute emissions and neglect of CBDR-RC.

new.s: In the Environmental Kuznets Curve, the X-axis shows:
new.x: The EKC plots per capita income on the X-axis against environmental degradation on the Y-axis.

new.s: The Environmental Kuznets Curve has the shape of:
new.x: Pollution rises at low incomes and falls after a turning point, giving an inverted U.

new.s: Simon Kuznets' original curve related per capita income to:
new.x: The original Kuznets Curve relates income to inequality; the Environmental Kuznets Curve relates income to degradation.

new.s: The Environmental Kuznets Curve was first shown for the environment by:
new.x: Grossman and Krueger first showed the curve for the environment in 1991.

new.s: According to the view that environmental protection is a necessity, degradation hurts growth by:
o: Raising health costs and lowering labour efficiency
new.x: The necessity view holds that degradation raises health costs and lowers labour efficiency.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT an example of resource depletion?
o: Groundwater falling due to deep bore tubewells
A forest managed sustainably for timber while keeping biodiversity
Habitats lost to expansion of agriculture
new.x: Depletion is use faster than regeneration; a forest managed sustainably while keeping biodiversity is not depletion.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the functions of the environment:
1. Supply of resources is its first function.
2. Recycling is one of its functions.
3. Aesthetic services such as scenery are one of its functions.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Resource supply (the first function) and aesthetic services are functions; recycling is not a function of the environment.

new.s: Urea accounts for about what share of fertiliser use in India?
new.x: Urea makes up about 56% of fertiliser use, and its overuse degrades soil and water.

new.s: Green urea is a low-carbon fertiliser made from:
new.x: Green urea is made from green hydrogen and captured CO2.

new.s: Green jobs are jobs that:
o: Are paid for by carbon taxes
new.x: Green jobs are those that preserve or restore environmental quality.

new.s: The SEEA Central Framework was adopted by the UN Statistical Commission in:
new.x: The UN Statistical Commission adopted the SEEA Central Framework in 2012; MoSPI accounts followed from 2018.

new.s: EnviStats India is brought out annually by:
new.x: MoSPI publishes EnviStats India and compiles environment accounts on the UN SEEA.

new.s: The EIA Notification of 2006 made environmental clearance compulsory for how many project categories?
new.x: The EIA Notification (1994, revised 2006) covers 39 project categories.

new.s: According to the ISRO-SAC Atlas (2021), the share of India's land degraded in 2018-19 was:
new.x: 97.85 Mha, or 29.77%, was degraded in 2018-19; 28.76% was the 2003-05 figure and 29.32% the 2011-13 figure.

new.s: Which districts of Andhra Pradesh are the most vulnerable to desertification?
new.x: Anantapur, Kurnool and Kadapa are the most desertification-vulnerable districts of AP.

new.s: The leading process of land degradation in India is:
new.x: Water erosion (10.98%) leads, followed by vegetation degradation (8.91%).

new.s: Between 2011 and 2020, India restored about how much degraded land?
new.x: India restored 21.76 Mha in 2011-2020, beating its original Bonn pledge; Telangana led with 4.18 Mha.

new.s: The Brundtland Report of 1987 is titled:
new.x: 'Our Common Future' (1987) is the Brundtland Report; 'Limits to Growth' is the Club of Rome's 1972 report.

new.s: Gro Harlem Brundtland, who chaired the WCED, was Prime Minister of:
new.x: Gro Harlem Brundtland was Prime Minister of Norway, not Sweden.

new.s: The World Summit on Sustainable Development (Rio+10) was held in Johannesburg in:
new.x: The Johannesburg World Summit of 2002 reviewed progress ten years after Rio.

new.s: The 1972 Stockholm Conference on the Human Environment led to the creation of:
new.x: Stockholm 1972 first put the environment on the global agenda and created UNEP.

new.s: The principle that lack of full scientific certainty is no reason to postpone action against serious environmental damage is the:
new.x: This is the precautionary principle endorsed at Rio 1992.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Rio 1992 principles:
1. The polluter pays principle was endorsed.
2. Common but differentiated responsibilities was endorsed.
3. Unrestricted resource exploitation was endorsed.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Polluter pays and CBDR were endorsed at Rio; unrestricted resource exploitation goes against sustainable development and was not.

new.s: How many unique global indicators are there for the SDGs?
new.x: The SDGs have 17 goals, 169 targets and 231 unique global indicators; 277 is India's National Indicator Framework 2026.

new.s: SDG 14 deals with:
new.x: SDG 14 is Life below water; SDG 15 is Life on land and SDG 13 Climate action.

new.s: Clean water and sanitation is the theme of:
new.x: SDG 6 is clean water and sanitation; SDG 7 is affordable and clean energy.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: SDG 5 is Gender equality; SDG 2 is Zero hunger, SDG 4 Quality education and SDG 15 Life on land.

new.s: The Millennium Development Goals had how many goals?
new.x: The MDGs had 8 goals for 2000-2015; the SDGs have 17.

new.s: Under the 'leave no one behind' principle of Agenda 2030, progress is measured by:
o: The poorest and most excluded groups
new.x: Leave no one behind measures progress by the poorest and most excluded, not by averages.

new.s: Earth Overshoot Day is computed by:
new.x: Earth Overshoot Day is computed yearly by the Global Footprint Network, not UNEP.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's SDG monitoring and reporting framework is part of the Planning Department's:
new.x: AP's SDG framework is part of ROMS of the Planning Department, with indicators tracked at state, district and secretariat levels.

new.s: Which body runs district monitoring and real-time dashboards for the Swarna Andhra @2047 vision?
new.x: The AP State Development Planning Society (APSDPS) of the Planning Department runs them.

new.s: In NITI Aayog's SDG India Index 2023-24, which States topped with a score of 79?
new.x: Kerala and Uttarakhand topped with 79; India scored 71 and Bihar was last with 57.

new.s: India's first Voluntary National Review (2017) covered how many SDGs?
new.x: India's first VNR in 2017 covered 7 SDGs: 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 14 and 17.
